text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Haa, haa... It won't go away! I just 
can't shake off this awful image, no 
matter what!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Being overpowered by Opera O-chan. Being 
passed from behind by Ayabe-san. Images 
like that keep...)

Training in preparation for the Japan 
Derby. Narita Top Road was struggling.

Admire Vega and T.M. Opera O. It seems 
their phantoms won't disappear, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there isn't really a huge 
difference in ability between the three of 
us, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why do those two frighten me this 
much?

—I think. The reason I can't help but 
picture "defeat" is...
choice_data_list:
Is it because the two of them have an 
absolute weapon...?

Maybe it's because both of them have an 
absolute weapon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: An absolute... weapon?
Yes, in other words—

T.M. Opera O possesses an "abnormal 
toughness." Just like she showed in that 
rainy Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Rough turf or a chaotic brawl, I 
welcome it all! For I am the heir of the 
sacred spring!

On the other hand, Admire Vega possesses 
"razor-sharp edge." A burst of late speed 
that could tear through anything.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A split second... is all I need. I'll shut 
every single one of those other girls up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, you're right... 
Those two have clear, defined strengths...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If it turns into their winning pattern, no 
one stands a chance. That's why I just 
couldn't help but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I don't possess a weapon like that, after 
all.

The analysis hit the mark. Narita Top Road 
does not have a single, distinct, 
overpowering strength.

It seemed she was feeling the weakness of 
her own strengths.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Especially... Ayabe-san. That turn of 
foot, almost like an obsession...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Where on earth does it come from? It seems 
like something that can't be explained by 
talent alone...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Finally... tomorrow is the Japan Derby...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I will dedicate this victory to you. To 
you—who should have been born alongside 
me."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry... If you try to save both 
of the twin sisters, then both of them...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Please, forgive me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
As your older sister... I'll run for your 
sake too. No...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I will run for you. Yes, for that is the 
reason I was born—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It was simply—to make amends.
And—the day of the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll do everything I can. In this 
race everyone dreams of. But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Those two really are formidable opponents. 
It all comes down to whether I can stand 
up to their absolute weapon...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
This is a formidable weapon in its own 
right!

text_block_list.text:
As I spoke, I handed Narita Top Road a 
single sheet of paper I had prepared.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is this paper...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
These are all the training records up to 
now, right? From gate dash speed to 
detailed lap times.
choice_data_list: Yeah, all of them are way above average.
Yeah, they're all way above average.

text_block_list.text:
Nothing stands out as exceptional. 
However, she has almost no weaknesses 
either. In other words, what this data 
indicates is—
choice_data_list:
Being well-rounded is a weapon in its own 
right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Such high... all-round ability...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Now that you mention it, that's 
true. As long as I don't fall into my 
losing pattern, I should be able to put up 
a fight.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, while it isn't on this 
checklist..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even I have something I'm stronger at than 
anyone else. I've only just realized it 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's... because I want to repay Trainer 
for always taking such good care of me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone beat these feelings in 
my heart right now. —Here I go.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.text:
I send Narita Top Road off with the most 
motivating words possible. After that—all 
I can do is watch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, Ayabe-san, looking forward 
to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make this a race with no regrets! 
Our once-in-a-lifetime Derby!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Sorry about the Satsuki Sho. It 
practically ended up like an ambush.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do not forget this time, however: I am the 
Umamusume truly worthy of victory.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I cannot lose, absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! Me too. Let's give it our all!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Hm, that is...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I see. I found another thing here in the 
paddock that I won't lose to anyone at.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (That is—)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: We're counting on you, Top Road!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Show us your best race ever! We believe 
in you!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(It's not just Trainer. I want to live up 
to everyone who's cheering for me with all 
their hearts!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(That handmade banner hanging on the 
fence. I'm going to run a race worthy of 
it!)

Her fans grew in number with each passing 
day. And along with them, Narita Top 
Road's feelings grew stronger and 
stronger.

The true strength of the weapons each of 
the three possessed was about to be put to 
the test.
